source: I want clicker game and I want a chill park map that I can walk around In with my roblox character. I want there to be a rebirth buttons that doubles clicks. An admin panel only i have and i can give any amount of clicks up to infinity and can start a 2x event and can talk to every globally in game. I want there to be an egg with pets a uncommon pig pet with a 60% chance to get, a rare cat with a 25% chance to get, an epic dog with a 10% chance to get, a legendary horse with a 1% chance, a mythic shark with a 0.1% chance, and a secret turtle with a 0.01% chance to get. I want no labels or texts on my screen or on the ground too

answers.ask: Should the park read as bright and cartoony, or a naturalistic modern city park?
answers.answer: Make it a bright, cartoony chill park that fits a Roblox clicker game.

answers.ask: Is the rebirth button a physical thing you walk up to in the park, or a screen button?
answers.answer: Make the rebirth button a physical button players walk up to in the park, with no text labels.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D game map as a bright, cartoony chill park that a Roblox character can freely walk around. Arrange open grassy paths and simple park scenery around a central physical rebirth button that players can walk up to; the button has no text label. Include a pet egg as a visible park prop or interaction point, also without ground text, signs, or on-screen labels.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation: an incremental clicker game. Its walkable park is a shared game world rather than a plot or a course.

### Shape and preset
Use `world-shared`, matching the Incremental Simulator preset. Here it is a compact, freely walkable park centered on the physical interaction landmarks rather than a dense commercial simulator plaza.

### Config requirements
Use visible `path-circulation` as broad, curving grassy and paved walking routes that converge on the park center. Use `trigger-rebirth`: the visible geometry is one large, text-free physical rebirth button on a small central pad; its activation volume is invisible and must not appear in renders. The pet egg is a visible standalone park prop and interaction point, with its interaction volume invisible. Do not render signs, ground text, screen UI, labels, probability displays, or other written markers.

### Layout components
Build one small central park zone, with the rebirth-button pad at its center and the pet egg placed nearby as a second focal prop, separated enough that each reads clearly. A loose ring of open grass, simple paved or worn paths, rounded trees, low flowerbeds, shrubs, and a few benches surrounds these landmarks, leaving generous unobstructed character-walking space. Curved paths connect every edge of the lawn to the central pad and egg area. Keep the terrain flat, with bright green grass and minimal decorative relief. The park has no hard architectural enclosure; use a soft outer edge of trees and shrubs rather than walls. Compose the map as a clean isometric park tableau, with the central button and egg immediately legible and no typography anywhere.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: render the cheerful visual composition first, since the park has no topology whose validity is required for play.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is small, driven by a single walkable park and two central interaction landmarks. Theme: bright, cartoony, relaxed Roblox park. Use `P0`; the flat, single-surface outdoor layout forces no additional capture path.
